تعتبري (form VIII)
# تَعْتَبِرِي (taʕtabirī) /taʕ.ta.bi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# تُعْتَبَرِي (tuʕtabarī) /tuʕ.ta.ba.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
